summary: This clinical trial studies how a drug called semaglutide affects alcohol consumption and liver health in people with obesity and fatty liver disease. The study plans to enroll 64 participants to test the effects of the drug alongside weight reduction recommendations. Insel Gruppe AG, University Hospital Bern is sponsoring the trial, which is currently Not yet recruiting. It is listed with NCT06546384.
